prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Deferred Flow: Reorder the onboarding flow so account sign-in happens after pet selection and adoption certificate generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Stage Layout for Path Selection: Redesign the choose path screen into a stage layout with interactive visual path cards.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Path", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose", "label": "Select Journey"}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough Screen: Insert a dedicated interactive desktop controls checklist screen right after home intro.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_guide"], "new_controls_guide": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Quick tips on how to summon, drag, talk to, and hide your pet on your desktop screen.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "rounded", "label": "Controls Overview"}]}}
3: [adoption, redesign] Two-Column Pet Customization Layout: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a two-column layout featuring a live preview of the pet alongside options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Design Your Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "highlight", "label": "Live Pet Preview"}]}}
4: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Quick Selection Hint: Display a hint on the choose path screen letting users know they can change their companion style later in settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "You can change your companion style anytime later in app settings."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Readiness Progress Display: Show an explicit progress bar and estimated time remaining during the desktop pet launch waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Companion", "body": "Setting up desktop overlay and background pet engine..."}}
6: [home, notification] Background Setup Desktop Notification Alert: Enable desktop notification alerts when the desktop pet generation finishes in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you when your pet is ready on your desktop!"}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Official Seal Badge: Add an official companion badge component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet setup.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Desktop Pet Adoption", "replace": {"official_stamp": [{"role": "official_stamp", "type": "badge", "text": "Registered Desktop Companion", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
8: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync and Pet Recovery Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in saves their pet and prevents reset.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sync & Preserve Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Sign in to save your pet companion, customize items, and protect your progress across app restarts."}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Companion Shortcut Controls Tip: Update home_intro text and hint to explain hotkeys for summoning and hiding the pet on desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "Use quick controls to interact with your pet anytime on screen.", "hint": "Right-click your pet to open actions, or drag it anywhere on screen!"}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur after adoption certificate is permitted by Rule 4.
Redesigning choose_path with a stage layout and choice cards retains the path selection functionality.
Adding a new controls walkthrough screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigning pick_friend layout with a live preview maintains pet selection capability.
Adding an informational hint to choose_path screen is allowed.
Adding a progress indicator and estimated wait time to the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding background completion notification hints for the waiting screen is allowed by Rule 4.
Replacing the stamp with a registration badge maintains the official adoption stamp function.
Updating sign_in copy to explain pet synchronization is allowed.
Updating home_intro text and hints with desktop control tips is allowed within onboarding.
